name: Gestures_Angry_2
short_caption: The robot slightly pulls its elbows back, tenses its posture, and turns its head sideways with a subtle tilt.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture, then pulls both of its elbows slightly backward and inward, creating a tensed torso alignment. Simultaneously, it turns its head to its left side with a subtle downward tilt, holding this rigid posture momentarily. Finally, it relaxes its arms and returns its head to the forward-facing neutral position.
